_comment: Canonical note types for decks built by this skill. Reuse them verbatim.
The ids are load-bearing: Anki's .apkg importer matches note types by id, and a
fresh timestamp id guarantees a 'Name+' fork in the user's collection.
NEVER change the fields or templates of a note type the user already has. A schema
difference forks it to 'Name+' unless the user ticks 'Merge notetypes' in the import
dialog, and that checkbox DEFAULTS TO OFF - so the fork is the normal outcome.
If you need a different card shape, add a NEW note type with a new id: one the
collection has never seen installs cleanly on default settings.

html_conventions.code_block_note:
The .code CSS sets white-space:normal, so line breaks MUST be
and indentation MUST be   pairs.

html_conventions.field_split: Front = the question. Back = the answer alone, kept short. Extra = elaboration, contrasts and examples (rules 4 and 7), rendered below a rule.
html_conventions.reversible: Use the 'basic_reversed' note type for cards worth drilling in both directions. Keep Back bare on those - it becomes the FRONT of the reverse card, so any elaboration there gives the answer away. Put it in Extra or a separate card.

known_collection_notetype_ids._comment: Stock note type ids seen in the user's own collection, for decks that must use a stock type instead of the skill's.
